title: Discovery of novel non-steroidal selective glucocorticoid receptor modulators by structure- and IGN-based virtual screening, structural optimization, and biological evaluation.
authors: Hu, Xueping; Pang, Jinping; Chen, Changwei; Jiang, Dejun; Shen, Chao; Chai, Xin; Yang, Liu; Zhang, Xujun; Xu, Lei; Cui, Sunliang; Hou, Tingjun; Li, Dan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接、IGN重打分和MD模拟发现非甾体选择性糖皮质激素受体调节剂，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作与AI/物理模拟方法，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Glucocorticoids (GCs) are the most commonly used anti-inflammatory drugs. However, their excellent therapeutic effects are often accompanied by undesirable side effects. To discover selective glucocorticoid receptor modulators (SGRMs) that preferentially induce transrepression with little or no transactivation activity, a structure-based virtual screening by combining molecular docking and InteractionGraphNet (IGN) rescoring was performed, and compound HP210 was identified. HP210 did not induce the transactivation functions of GR while still acted on the NF-kappaB mediated tethered transrepression function (IC(50) = 2.32 muM), and suppressed the secretion of pro-inflammation cytokines IL-1beta and IL-6. Compared with dexamethasone, HP210 showed no cross activities with phylogenetically related mineralcorticoid receptor and progesterone receptor and no significant effect on osteoprotegerin, exhibiting a reduced side-effect profile. Then, guided by the molecular dynamics simulations and binding free energy calculations, compound HP210_b4 with over two-fold higher transrepression activity (IC(50) = 0.99 muM) was discovered. This study reported a group of non-steroidal new-scaffold SGRMs, providing valuable clues for the development of novel anti-inflammatory drugs.
abstract_zh: 糖皮质激素（GCs）是最常用的抗炎药物。然而，其卓越的治疗效果往往伴随着不良副作用。为了发现优先诱导反式抑制且几乎无或完全没有反式激活活性的选择性糖皮质激素受体调节剂（SGRMs），我们通过结合分子对接和InteractionGraphNet（IGN）重评分的基于结构的虚拟筛选，鉴定出化合物HP210。HP210不诱导GR的反式激活功能，但仍作用于NF-kappaB介导的束缚型反式抑制功能（IC(50) = 2.32 muM），并抑制促炎细胞因子IL-1beta和IL-6的分泌。与地塞米松相比，HP210对系统发育相关的盐皮质激素受体和孕激素受体无交叉活性，且对骨保护素无显著影响，表现出较低的副作用特征。随后，在分子动力学模拟和结合自由能计算的指导下，发现了反式抑制活性提高两倍以上的化合物HP210_b4（IC(50) = 0.99 muM）。本研究报道了一组非甾体新型骨架SGRMs，为新型抗炎药物的开发提供了宝贵线索。
